PAKISTAN BAR COUNCIL (RECOGNITION OF UNIVERSITIES) (AMENDMENT) RULES,
2010
PAKISTAN BAR COUNCIL (RECOGNITION OF UNIVERSITIES) (AMENDMENT) RULES, 2010
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 13th April, 2010]
S.R.O. 244(I)/2010,
dated 13-4-2010.---In exercise of the powers conferred by sections 13(k) and
55(q) of the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973 (XXXV of 1973) and
other enabling provisions in this behalf, the Pakistan Bar Council hereby makes
and notifies the following amendments in the Pakistan Bar Council (Recognition
of Universities) Rules, 2005.
1. Short title
and commencement.---(i) These
Rules may be called the "Pakistan Bar Council (Recognition of
Universities) (Amendment) Rules, 2010";
(ii) They shall
come into force at once.
2. Amendment in
Second Schedule under Rule 4.--The
following Universities having been recognized by the Pakistan Bar Council from
the dates mentioned against each of them in terms of sections 13(1)(k) and
26(c)(iii) of the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973, are listed in
and added to the Second Schedule prepared under Rule 4 of the Pakistan Bar
Council (Recognition) of Universities Rules, 2005:
(A) Pakistani
Universities/Degree Awarding Institutions:
(1) University
of Sargodha (w.e.f. 16-3-2006).
(2) Government
College University, Faisalabad (with effect from 4-7-2006).
(3) Dadabhoy
Institute of Higher Education, Karachi (w.e.f. 18-10-2006).
(4) University
of South Asia, Lahore (w.e.f. 27-3-2008).
(5) Hazara
University, Mansehra (w.e.f. 14-5-2008).
(B) Foreign
University:
(1) University of
Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Muzaffarabad (w.e.f. 1-7-2008).
3. Amendment of
Rules 5.--(1) The figure, signs
and words "100,000 (Rupees One Hundred Thousand only)"
appearing in clause (i) of Rule 5, may be substituted by the figure, signs and
words "10,00,000 (Rupees Ten Hundred Thousand only)"; and
(2) The figure and signs "15,000" may be
substituted by the figure and signs "25,000".
